cohort: 170 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies between 28-36 weeks gestation with a history of at least one D&C, C-section, hysterotomy, or open abdominal myomectomy performed more than 6 months prior and parity ≥1, excluding those with diabetes mellitus, hypertension, and hyperlipidemia.
finding: Adherent placenta was observed in 5.9% of the participants.
